हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Immortal for 3000 is a supernatural action drama where ancient Indian mythology collides with the modern world. The story follows Rishi Vedant, a yogi who awakens after 3000 years of penance, only to find himself in the chaos of Kalyug. Gifted with divine powers, Vedant must confront dark forces, black magic, and betrayal while protecting humanity from rising evil. As he navigates modern society and forms unexpected bonds, his true test begins—facing both external demons and the shadows hidden in human greed and desire.
